formulaIdentity.productName: Head & Shoulders DERMAXPRO Shampoo Beruhigende Pflege
formulaIdentity.fingerprintMethod: sha256 of packet canonicalInci joined with ', '
formulaIdentity.sourceTier: frozen packet canonical INCI; positioning: 1 manufacturer + 3 retailers
formulaIdentity.conflictNotes: Claims name 'Ceramide(-Komplex)', 'Kaktus-Extrakt' and 'Vitamin E'; no ceramide, cactus (Opuntia) or Tocopherol entry in the INCI. None is a dandruff active, silicone or closed-list E4 gate route, so per ID-3 these are notes with no confidence effect. 'Aloe' maps to Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice (24).

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2, ether type) buffered by prominent Cocamidopropyl Betaine (4); no prominent reinforcing anionic. TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate (17) is after Parfum (12) and recorded only (C4). Counter-signals toward strong: that late sulfonate, hydrotrope Sodium Xylenesulfonate (3) and Cocamide MEA (9) (not routes, C3); confidence moderate.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High by C2: early (prominent) silicone Dimethiconol (7), pearlizing/fatty route Glycol Distearate (10), cationic polymer Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (14), second silicone Dimethicone (13), humectants Butylene Glycol (23), Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice (24), Propylene Glycol (32). Counter-signal toward moderate: the humectant element is only glycols/aloe late in the list (no glycerin/panthenol); confidence moderate. C2 says strong-ish cleansing does not lower it.

excluded: Oryza Sativa Bran Extract (30): trace extract

depositionLoad.rationale: Prominent Dimethiconol plus Dimethicone and guar coacervate: a real deposition system, but no lipid or film reinforcement.

persistence.rationale: Silicones are persistent; single polymer and no waxy lipid limit accumulation.

resetCapacity.rationale: C1 SLES/betaine chassis, late sulfonate; ordinary reset.

weightPotential.counterevidence: Early dimethiconol (7) and two silicones argue toward high; absence of any payload lipid, film former or second polymer and an effective SLES base argue against it.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: One meaningfully persistent silicone/guar system against ordinary reset leaves noticeable but bounded residue.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: deposition comes from one silicone/guar system without W-RICH (no prominent payload lipid) and reset is not limited. Not low: a prominent silicone with a cationic guar is plausible enough that lightweight would understate residue (W2).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Dimethiconol emulsion level/MW unknown; could move it one band toward high.
weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: silicone/guar system (7, 13, 14), no rich lipid architecture, moderate reset. W1 conditions not strictly met (no amodimethicone), full 6.6 method decides; result coincides.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Menthol (16) and fragrance in a scalp-soothing product; no E4 comfort route prominent; strong-leaning SLES chassis.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Manufacturer: 'Anti-Schuppen Wirkung mit Pirocton Olamin' (E2 dandruff unit, moderate) plus recognized active Piroctone Olamine (6) -> 7.2 problem-led dandruff row -> scalp_active. No lengths-care role in the product name ('Beruhigende Pflege' is not a lengths role), so F7 does not move it.
focusPrimary.rationale: scalp_active by 7.2: anti-dandruff positioning with a recognized active.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered. 'Feuchtigkeitsspendend' refers to scalp moisture and the formula has no moisture_supported cluster (glycols/aloe late); 'geschmeidiges Haar' is an outcome of the silicone route (F2).

triggerEvidence: Manufacturer: 'Anti-Schuppen Wirkung mit Pirocton Olamin - klinisch getestet' (moderate)
usageRole.decisionTrace: Default regular considered; dandruffSupport supported and qualifying E2 dandruff unit graded moderate -> treatment (U3). No reset, no frequency trigger; treatment wins by U1 anyway.
usageRole.rationale: Treatment: recognized active plus moderate-graded dandruff claim (U3).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Explicit positioning exists: manufacturer 'Shampoo gegen Kopfhautjucken' and 'Sofortige Linderung juckender Kopfhaut' are E2 sensitive units not naming dandruff (SC1, moderate); other itch/dryness units name 'Schuppen' and are absorbed as dandruff symptoms (E2a). But the formula lacks a credible supportive architecture: SLES chassis with late sulfonate, Menthol (16), Parfum, no E4 comfort route, no glycerin/panthenol; only Aloe juice (24) and glycols late. The itch relief rests on the anti-dandruff active. Hence not_targeted, moderate (neighbor targeted).

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W moderate, C high: fine acceptable, normal ideal, coarse ideal. Dandruff target; no not_suited fit so T6 does not lift anything. T4: normal ideal -> W neighbor high gives acceptable (lower) -> flag normal. Coarse ideal -> C neighbor moderate gives acceptable (lower) -> flag coarse (W neighbor high keeps ideal). Fine acceptable -> W neighbor high gives not_suited, lifted back by T6 -> no flag.
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-DANDRUFF: manufacturer E2 dandruff unit (moderate) and dandruffSupport supported (high) -> pass; confidence moderate. S-SENSITIVE: manufacturer itch units exist but formula gate fails (scalpComfortTarget not_targeted; no prominent E4 comfort route) -> note claimed_target_not_projected:sensitive. S-DRY: only non-dandruff dry unit is retailer copy ('für trockene, juckende Kopfhaut', low) -> positioning fails -> note claimed_target_not_projected:dry. Another target passed, so no S-FAIL flag.
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1: moderate -> regular, equals schuppen expectation. I3: neighbor strong with usageRole treatment -> regular, still matches -> no flag.

uncertainties: Whether 'gegen Kopfhautjucken' in an anti-dandruff product's headline is a stand-alone sensitive unit or implicitly a dandruff symptom: E2a absorbs only units that name 'Schuppen', so it was treated as sensitive; outcome is unchanged because the sensitive formula gate fails either way.
C2 humectant element satisfied only by late glycols/aloe.
